verdict.rationale: Vercel documents separate preview vs. production environments (vercel-docs-1, vercel-docs-8) and identity-based access controls for deployments (vercel-docs-13), which support some separation of environments, but there is no explicit documentation of network-level isolation preventing preview/staging environments from reaching production services or databases. Community evidence (vercel-comm-11) indicates that secure environment-to-database connectivity beyond a password requires contacting enterprise sales, suggesting this isolation is not a standard, fully self-serve capability. missing for 10: explicit network/VPC-level isolation between environments, documented controls preventing non-prod from reaching prod services, and evidence this works without enterprise sales escalation.
